help: bind the owner first, in a statement of its own: `let owned = made(..)`, then project `owned`

labels.message: this temporary ends at the end of its statement

diagnostics.message: `name` points into a temporary that ends with its statement
notes: a temporary lives until the end of the statement that makes it (a branch of an `if` or a `match` ends its own), so nothing used after that can keep a projection of it (§6.1)
diagnostics.title: a binding that keeps a projection of a temporary
